svg.style: background:#0f172a; font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;

g.data-hint: ♥ to — Tricky Word: The "o" makes an /oo/ sound instead of short /o/.
♥ the — Tricky Word: The "e" doesn’t say /e/, it makes a soft unaccented "uh" (schwa) sound.
♥ He — Tricky Word: The single "e" makes a long /ee/ sound.
♥ Come — Tricky Word: Rhymes with some. The "o" makes a short /uh/ sound.
♥ some — Tricky Word: The "o" makes an /uh/ sound like "sum", with a silent e.
♥ said — Tricky Word: The "ai" makes a short /e/ sound instead of /ay/. Rhymes with bed!
♥ We — Tricky Word: The single "e" makes a long /ee/ sound.
♥ like — Tricky Word: Split digraph: magic e makes the i say its own name!
♥ to — Tricky Word: The "o" makes an /oo/ sound instead of short /o/.
♥ the — Tricky Word: The "e" doesn’t say /e/, it makes a soft unaccented "uh" (schwa) sound.
♥ was — Tricky Word: The "a" makes an /o/ sound, and the "s" makes a buzzing /z/ sound!
♥ to — Tricky Word: The "o" makes an /oo/ sound instead of short /o/.

svg.text: Tap any word above to see & hear its sounds
